description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Credentials" name="Login credentials"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginSuccess" name="Successful login confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginFailure" name="Unsuccessful login confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Product" name="Selected product"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MoreProducts" name="More products needed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AllProductsSelected" name="All products selected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BankConfirmation" name="Bank payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AddressDetails" name="Address details"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shop" name="E-Shop system" processRef="Process_Shop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Credentials" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Start_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_Credentials"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginSuccess" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Catch_LoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginFailure" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginFailure" targetRef="Catch_LoginFailure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Product" sourceRef="Task_SendProduct" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProduct" messageRef="Message_Product"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MoreProducts" sourceRef="Task_SendMoreProducts" targetRef="Catch_MoreProducts" messageRef="Message_MoreProducts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AllProductsSelected" sourceRef="Task_SendAllProductsSelected" targetRef="Catch_AllProductsSelected" messageRef="Message_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentData" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Participant_Bank" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankConfirmationShop" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="Catch_BankConfirmation" messageRef="Message_BankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankConfirmationCustomer" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="Catch_CustomerBankConfirmation" messageRef="Message_BankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AddressDetails" sourceRef="Task_SendAddressDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddressDetails" messageRef="Message_AddressDetails"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ordering" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin shopping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in and submit credentials"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_LoginResponse" name="Wait for login confirmation" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_LoginSuccess" name="Login successful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginSuccess" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_LoginFailure" name="Login unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginFailure" messageRef="Message_LoginFailure"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginFailure" name="Shopping stops"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select a product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddProduct" name="Add product to cart"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProduct" name="Submit selected product" messageRef="Message_Product"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_SelectionResponse" name="Wait for selection status" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_MoreProducts" name="More products needed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_MoreProducts" messageRef="Message_MoreProducts"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_AllProductsSelected" name="All products selected">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AllProductsSelected" messageRef="Message_AllProductsSelected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerWorkSplit" name="Enter payment data and address"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentData" name="Submit payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CustomerBankConfirmation" name="Wait for bank payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerBankConfirmation" messageRef="Message_BankConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddress" name="Is the billing address different?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter independent billing address"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAddressDetails" name="Submit address details" messageRef="Message_AddressDetails"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerWorkJoin" name="Payment and address steps completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Customer steps completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Gateway_LoginResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginResponse" targetRef="Catch_LoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginResponse" targetRef="Catch_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Catch_LoginFailure" targetRef="End_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Catch_LoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" sourceRef="Task_AddProduct" targetRef="Task_SendProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Task_SendProduct" targetRef="Gateway_SelectionResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectionResponse" targetRef="Catch_MoreProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_11" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectionResponse" targetRef="Catch_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_12" sourceRef="Catch_MoreProducts" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_13" sourceRef="Catch_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_14" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_15" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_16" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Catch_CustomerBankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_17" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_18" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_19" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddress" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shippingAddressDifferentFromBillingAddress</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_20" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddress" targetRef="Task_SendAddressDetails">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shippingAddressEqualsBillingAddress</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_21" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Task_SendAddressDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_22" sourceRef="Task_SendAddressDetails" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_23" sourceRef="Catch_CustomerBankConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_24" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerWorkJoin" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shop" name="E-Shop order processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LoginRequest" name="Login request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_Credentials"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Credentials" name="Are credentials valid?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginSuccess" name="Confirm successful login" messageRef="Message_LoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginFailure" name="Confirm unsuccessful login" messageRef="Message_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProduct" name="Receive selected product" messageRef="Message_Product"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckSelection" name="Check whether every product has been selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllSelected" name="Are all products selected?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMoreProducts" name="Request remaining products" messageRef="Message_MoreProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAllProductsSelected" name="Confirm all products selected" messageRef="Message_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinishInitialOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment simultaneously"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Payment and shipment prepared"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit" name="Wait for payment and address steps"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePaymentData" name="Receive payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send payment request to bank" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_BankConfirmation" name="Receive bank payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankConfirmation" messageRef="Message_BankConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAddressDetails" name="Receive address details" messageRef="Message_AddressDetails"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin" name="Payment and address steps completed"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinishFinalOrder" name="Finish order after payment and address steps"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderFinished" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_1" sourceRef="Start_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_Credentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Credentials" targetRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">credentialsValid</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Credentials" targetRef="Task_SendLoginFailure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not credentialsValid</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_5" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_6" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginFailure" targetRef="End_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProduct" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_8" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_9" sourceRef="Task_CheckSelection" targetRef="Gateway_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_10" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="Task_SendMoreProducts">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not allProductsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_11" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="Task_SendAllProductsSelected">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allProductsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_12" sourceRef="Task_SendMoreProducts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_13" sourceRef="Task_SendAllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_FinishInitialOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_14" sourceRef="Task_FinishInitialOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_15" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_16" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_17" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_18" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_19" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_20" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_21" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePaymentData" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_22" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Catch_BankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_23" sourceRef="Catch_BankConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_24" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddressDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_25" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAddressDetails" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_26" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin" targetRef="Task_FinishFinalOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_27" sourceRef="Task_FinishFinalOrder" targetRef="End_OrderFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
